Effective thickness
The effective thickness of walls and columns for use in the calculation of
slenderness ratio, shall be defined as follows:
(a)  Solid Walls: The effective thickness of solid walls, faced walls or
grouted walls shall be the specified thickness of the wall.
Chapter 7
(b)  Solid Walls with Raked Mortar Joints: The effective thickness of solid
walls with raked mortar joints shall be the minimum thickness
measured at the joint.
